screen_rows.pattern: ^(?:◈|◆|◇) (?:Thinking(?: \(\d+s · esc to interrupt\))?|Working \(\d+s · esc to interrupt\))$

screen_rows.note: Wrapped transcript continuations and queued-item rows are indented content; depth generalises past the captured two spaces because continuations preserve leading spaces. Chrome is positional (r14): header text is chrome only as the first nonblank row, notice text only right after the header; the same text elsewhere is indented content. No glyph is excluded: every (previous, current) row-state pair goes through the closed transition table, and a first-row continuation admits only with log backing.
Cleared on drain; post_drain harvest shows no queue rows at quiet idle.
